items.title: Witch Sorting Autumn Leaves
items.alt: A witch sorts maple, oak and birch leaves on a small cloth.
items.description: A witch sits cross-legged and arranges three distinct autumn leaves in separate open spaces on a small cloth. Use this illustration for leaf identification crafts and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch Inspecting a Snow Globe
items.alt: A witch examines a glass globe containing a crescent and stars.
items.description: A quiet witch holds a glass globe containing a tiny crescent and three stars at eye level, with careful fingers around its base. Use this illustration for imaginative observation stories and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch Playing a Small Harp
items.alt: A witch plays a small crescent-shaped harp while seated on a cushion.
items.description: A witch sits on a low cushion and plucks a compact crescent-shaped harp, both hands positioned on its separated strings. Use this illustration for music-themed fantasy cards and personal crafts.
